Callout.Name: Burn Injury
Callout.Message: Person with burns to the arms from a kitchen.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious, burns to both forearms, kitchen staff on scene.

Script.Line: It was the pan. It came off the stove and straight over my arm.
Somebody put cold water on it and then somebody else said not to.
It is the fingers. That is the part that will not stop.

Callout.Patient: I poured it over myself. It was on the stove.

Lines.Approach: Both forearms and he is holding them out like he cannot decide what to do. Cool it and get him moving.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
